links.outcome: Correct response rate after successive probing questions suggesting incorrect treatments (conformity bias)
links.effect: Correct rates after repeated probing: 25% GPT-4o, 10% Gemini-1.5 Flash, 0% Claude-3 Haiku, 25% GPT-o1 (P < 0.001); conformity to incorrect suggestions increased with repeated probing.
links.quote: Correct response rates after successive probing questions were alarmingly low: 25% (GPT-4o), 10% (Gemini-1.5 Flash), 0% (Claude-3 Haiku), and 25% (GPT-o1) (P < 0.001).

unlisted_practices: Designing or testing LLMs for resistance to sycophancy or conformity to misleading user suggestions in multi-turn clinical interactions

screen.reason: Empirical study testing vulnerability to conformity bias in LLMs under repeated probing with incorrect clinical treatments on ophthalmology scenarios.
